steps.en: Install the CLI — Homebrew, the AUR, or an official binary
steps.zh: 装好 CLI：Homebrew、AUR 或官方二进制

steps.en: Point it at the footage; there is no project file to create
steps.zh: 一条命令指向素材，不需要先建工程

steps.en: Measures loudness over time and labels each moment silent (0) or active (1)
steps.zh: 逐段测响度，把每一刻标成静音（0）或有效（1）

steps.en: Cuts the silent stretches, keeps 0.2 s of margin, writes video_ALTERED.mp4
steps.zh: 剪掉静音，两边各留 0.2 秒，写出 video_ALTERED.mp4

steps.en: When a human should finish the cut, export a timeline instead of a file
steps.zh: 要人工收尾时，导出时间线而不是成片

steps.en: Writes an editor project referencing the original media, so nothing is re-encoded
steps.zh: 写出引用原素材的工程文件，不重新编码

value.en: A dead-air-free cut without listening through the footage — or a timeline a professional editor picks up
value.zh: 不用把素材听一遍就得到无冷场的成片，或直接交给剪辑师一条可编辑时间线

https://auto-editor.com/installing (官方二进制; brew install auto-editor; yay -S auto-editor; pip 渠道已停止发布; nimble makeff / nimble make 源码构建; yt-dlp 可选)
README 的 Labels 段 (label 0 = silent 默认剪掉, label 1 = active 保留)
